target: UTM-bundled QEMU on macOS, AArch64 PCI guest, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-budget-program-current-55719-2026-11-11.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-budget-program
verified: Budget menu and shortcut hover continue presenting frames without failed tasks.
The real entry form creates an entry; save, abort, edit and cancellation behave as expected.
The saved entry reopens, and its data persists across a cold boot with only the VirtIO disk.
Each app exit returns to a graphical terminal where 40+2 evaluates to 42.
not_verified: Visible UTM app-window acceptance: an earlier user report described Budget freezing; this QEMU automation does not resolve that report.
Account file editing and account selection workflows are not covered by this probe.
